title: 第638章 岁岁哥哥      找到待在你身边的办法了第637章 那你问它
slug: 满级雷灵根卷哭修仙界
lines: 火刚烧起来，远处就出现了一排人影。
林枝意抬头看了一眼，又低头继续翻手里的饼。
钱多多也抬头看了一眼，又低头继续拨火堆。
那排人影越走越近，领头的正是陈敬。
他法袍上沾满了灰，鞋底磨薄了一层，走到火堆十几步远的地方停下来，弯腰撑着膝盖喘了好一会儿才直起身："你们走太快了，我跟不上。"
林枝意没抬头："你跟着我们干什么？"
陈敬张了张嘴，没说出话来。他身后那十几个人也跟着停了，有人扶着膝盖喘气，有人蹲下来揉脚踝。
七零八落的，像一群被风吹散又被风吹拢的枯叶。
钱多多扫了一眼那些人："这些都是你招的？"
"不是。"
陈敬的声音带着一种说不清道不明的疲惫，
"我没招他们。我蹲在谷口等你们，蹲到第三天，有两个人路过，问我蹲在那里干什么。我说我在等一队人出来。他们就跟着蹲下来了。第四天又来了一拨，也蹲下来了。"
钱多多沉默了一下："所以你蹲了三天，蹲出一支队伍？"
"我也没想到。"陈敬说，"我以为他们跟半天就会走。结果跟了五天。"
那十几个人里有一个穿灰色短打的年轻人在后面开了口，声音不大但能听清："我们不是跟着他，是跟着你们。"
林枝意终于抬起头。她看了那个年轻人一眼，目光里没有问号，像是一个已经知道答案的人在等对方自己把话说完。
那个年轻人被她看得往后缩了半步，但还是把话说完了：
"你们挖到的东西我们也想要。不是抢，就想知道那是什么。我们在这挖了快两个月，什么都没挖到。你们一来就挖到了，肯定有原因。"
林枝意看了他两息，把手里那块烤好的干粮掰了一半递给钱多多，站起来拍了拍手上的碎屑："你们想要什么？"
那个年轻人咽了一下唾沫："能不能……让我们跟着走一段？"
陈敬站在旁边没出声，脚跟在地上蹭了好几下。
林枝意看了那排人一眼："出事自己跑，别喊我们救。"
陈敬愣了一息："真的？"
"假的。"林枝意已经坐回火堆边了，"你们自己走，别挡路就行。"
钱多多蹲在火堆旁边，声音压得很低："这就收编了？"
云逸抱着陨星也蹲过来，跟着小声接了一句："好像不算收编。"
"那算什么？"
"算……暂时同意同行。"
"那不还是收编吗？"
云逸想了想："那得看他们能跟多远。"
柳轻舞把流光横在膝盖上，素玉浮在肩侧：
"他们挖了两个月什么都没挖到，缺的不是运气，是方向。跟着我们，只是想找到那个方向。"
林枝意喝着水，目光越过水囊边缘，落在远处那排蹲在风口里的散修身上。他们蹲的位置背风，能看到火堆，又不会挡路。她收回目光继续喝她的水。
李寒风坐在火堆侧后方，火光在他脸上晃。他手里捏着一块干粮但没有吃，目光落在远处那排散修身上。过了一会儿他开口了，声音不高不低：
"左起第三个，蹲了半盏茶换了一次脚。他不是在等，是在站岗。"
钱多多转头看过去。左起第三个果然蹲得很稳，目光一直落在火堆方向。
"……你怎么看出来的？"
"他换脚的时候脚跟没落地。不累的人不会这么换。"李寒风把干粮翻了个面，咬了一口，"他以前干过哨兵。"
"你怎么知道他以前干过哨兵？"
content_en:
As soon as the fire started, a row of figures appeared in the distance.
Lin Zhiyi raised his head and glanced up, then lowered his head and continued to flip the cake in his hand.
Qian Duoduo also looked up, then lowered his head and continued to stir the fire.
The row of figures was getting closer and closer, and the leader was none other than Chen Jing.
His robe was stained with ashes, and the soles of his shoes were worn thin. He walked a dozen steps away from the fire and stopped. He bent down and propped up his knees to catch his breath for a while before straightening up: "You are walking too fast, I can't keep up."
Lin Zhiyi did not raise his head: "Why are you following us?"
Chen Jing opened his mouth, but no words came out. The dozen or so people behind him also stopped. Some people held their knees to catch their breath, while others squatted down and rubbed their ankles.
They are scattered, like a group of dead leaves that have been blown away and blown back by the wind.
Qian Duoduo glanced at those people: "Did you recruit all of these?"
"No."
Chen Jing's voice was filled with an indescribable tiredness.
"I didn't recruit them. I squatted at the mouth of the valley waiting for you. On the third day, two people passed by and asked me what I was squatting there. I said I was waiting for a group of people to come out. They squatted down. On the fourth day, another group came and also squatted down."
Qian Duoduo was silent for a moment: "So you squatted for three days and formed a team?"
"I didn't expect it either." Chen Jing said, "I thought they would leave after a long time. But they followed for five days."
Among the dozen or so people, a young man wearing a gray bunt spoke from behind. His voice was not loud but could be heard clearly: "We are not following him, we are following you."
Lin Zhiyi finally raised his head. She glanced at the young man, with no question marks in her eyes, like someone who already knew the answer and was waiting for the other person to finish speaking.
The young man took half a step back when she saw him, but he still finished his words:
"We also want what you dug up. We don't want to rob it, we just want to know what it is. We have been digging here for almost two months and haven't found anything. There must be a reason why you dug it up as soon as you came here."
Lin Zhiyi looked at him for a moment, broke half of the roasted dry food in his hand and handed it to Qian Duoduo. He stood up and patted the crumbs on his hand: "What do you want?"
The young man swallowed and said, "Can... let us follow you for a while?"
Chen Jing stood aside without making a sound, rubbing his heels on the ground several times.
Lin Zhiyi glanced at the row of people: "If something happens, just run away. Don't call us to save you."
Chen Jing was stunned for a breath: "Really?"
"False." Lin Zhiyi had already sat back by the fire, "You just go on your own and don't block the way."
Qian Duoduo squatted next to the fire and said in a low voice: "Is this going to be included?"
Yun Yi squatted over with Yue Xing in his arms, and whispered, "It doesn't seem to be considered recruitment."
"What's that?"
"Forget it...I agree to go with you for the time being."
"Isn't that still compilation?"
Yun Yi thought for a while: "It depends on how far they can follow."
Liu Qingwu put the streamer across her knees, and the plain jade floated on her shoulders:
"They dug for two months and found nothing. What they lacked was not luck, but direction. They followed us just to find that direction."
Lin Zhiyi drank water, looking over the edge of the water bag and landing on the row of casual cultivators squatting in the wind vent in the distance. They were squatting in a position with the wind out of the way, allowing them to see the fire without blocking their way. She looked away and continued to drink her water.
Li Hanfeng sat behind the fire, the firelight shining on his face. He held a piece of dry food in his hand but did not eat it. His eyes fell on the row of casual cultivators in the distance. After a while he spoke, his voice neither high nor low:
"The third one from the left squatted for half a cup of tea and changed his feet. He is not waiting, but standing guard."
Qian Duoduo turned around and looked over. The third one from the left squatted very steadily, his eyes always focused on the direction of the fire.
"...How did you tell?"
"When he changed his feet, his heels did not touch the ground. People who are not tired would not change like this." Li Hanfeng turned over the dry food and took a bite. "He has been a sentry before."
"How do you know he's fucked a sentinel before?"
